label: Typed difference geometry
title: Groovy measures when a change forgets where it lives
summary: The dimensional beam section commutes exactly. Centered G instead measures basepoint dependence of finite-difference transport along the rule's own displacement; the lift's temporal rows store the corresponding two-step change data.
takeaway: For a nonlinear rule, a change is not enough to predict how that change evolves: where the change lives is part of the state needed to transport it.
